world_location_entrance_table.layout: $FF no-boundary marker + u8 count + count*{u8 x,u8 y} + count*{u8 destination scene,u8 destination x,u8 destination y}
world_location_entrance_table.endianness: not applicable; all fields are independent u8 values

address_meaning.source_x_y: world-map cell that activates the entrance
address_meaning.destination_scene_id: scene loaded after the coordinate match
address_meaning.destination_x_y: actual landing cell in the destination scene

world_location_entrance_table.algorithm_detail: $B14E scans the two-byte coordinate columns, preserves the current world scene/position through $D9C7, then uses the same row index in the parallel three-byte destination columns
world_location_entrance_table.capacity_and_writeback: fixed $4F records; coordinates and targets are editable in place; record insertion/removal and count changes are not supported
